assignments.task_summary: Implement the one bounded integration repair justified by day 272 diagnosis and compare repaired/unrepaired predictions on a sealed eight-request transfer fixture.
Complete a timed SQL mock deriving model-quality denominators from request, prediction and delayed-label rows, then execute one corrected counterexample from the debrief.
Run the already prepared model/data reproduction smoke and safe local rollback demonstration, then execute the claim-to-receipt checker over this exact candidate.

Use the actual prior checkpoint evidence and target-role feedback to select one bounded independent change, then execute one invariant/counterexample model and write its learner-owned decomposition. The source-impact explorer is the concrete default, not an obligation to add an unneeded feature.
Author and execute the explorer actor-access decision table using existing public module contracts.
Implement a pure version-relationship validator that uses explicit source relationships instead of timestamps.
Design and implement the value object that binds a comparison to two exact source versions and digests.
Write the comparison response contract and execute its serializer/decoder oracle before adding a controller.
Implement deterministic added/removed/changed/unchanged classification from the exact clause-ID maps.
Execute a small query/model experiment comparing on-demand derivation with a version-bound stored comparison receipt.
Create a new regression that compares a later source version while resolving an older policy citation.
Implement one misuse test against the proposed explorer boundary and make the smallest contract correction.
Author and test the request resource-budget decision for one pair comparison.
Implement an executable UI-state reducer/model separating URL pair selection from fetched results and local expansion state.
Find and repair a seeded predicate that treats a matching digest as proof that a source is applicable.
Run a bounded baseline for the learner-designed comparison without optimizing it yet.
Author the first contract-level failing test for the selected independent slice and prove the harness distinguishes a correct and defective implementation.
Implement one additive relational migration for the approved comparison receipt, or its on-demand alternative if the earlier ADR rejected storage.
Author one bounded SQL read for the two exact source versions through the owning module.
Implement range validation for comparison citations before they become view data.
Implement one service orchestration seam using public source-module interfaces and the learner's comparison algorithm.
Rebuild the pure classifier from its contract in a fresh assessment seam without viewing the earlier implementation.
Implement one explicitly versioned comparison-normalization policy while preserving original citation text.
Implement result rows for unchanged clauses with independent references to both source versions.
Implement comparison rows that distinguish an observed text change from missing or unverified evidence.
Profile one large permitted comparison and test resource rejection at the boundary.
Implement cancellation/deadline checks across the existing synchronous comparison port without adding a queue service.
Implement the bounded fan-out policy for a small multi-pair explorer request.
Implement and test the public-module adapter consumed by the explorer.
Implement the TanStack query-options factory from the actual comparison input contract.
Implement invalidation for an existing source-version status-change notification fixture.
Add a cross-layer regression for an old comparison deep link after a newer source appears.
Implement one reusable typed pair-selection composition used by the explorer and an existing source-history view.
Implement the shared clause-difference row using exact citations and inert source text.
Implement the route-state encoder/decoder for source pair and bounded comparison filters.
Implement the explorer's local expansion and filter behavior without copying query results into a second mutable store.
Implement optional private case context around an otherwise public comparison without widening permissions.
Repair a seeded query-key/cancellation defect causing an old pair response to overwrite the newly selected pair.
Implement the runtime decoder for comparison result rows before data enters typed components.
Implement error/retry presentation for a failed comparison query using the existing query adapter.
Implement one allowlisted diagnostic event for comparison stage timing.
Measure one repeated-render problem under a fixed comparison dataset and test a narrow UI change.
Connect the already completed backend/query/UI seams and execute one prepared end-to-end synthetic comparison.
Implement one compatibility check for rolling back the explorer code while retaining its additive data.
Run the independent slice from a clean approved local state and repair one reproduction ambiguity.
Translate a new source-withdrawal requirement into an executable transition model before changing implementation.
Implement the bounded SQL projection that joins immutable versions with the current permitted visibility generation.
Implement a compare-before-publish generation fence for one existing comparison result.
Add an end-to-end regression around the new publication fence with a deliberately delayed result.
Implement the client-side invalidation/removal policy for a withdrawn source while preserving unrelated public data.
